क्षेत्र
THE FIELD IT RISES FROM

First there is the land — a field held sacred before a single stone was dressed. On it the mandir rises, course by course. And at its heart will stand the garbhagṛha, holding the Shivling and the Jaladhari: the actual thing every page of this site walks toward.
